headline: Sensex Jumps 600 Points and Nifty Tops 25,400 as Nifty Bank Hits Record High

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong performance in the banking and FMCG sectors driving the indices higher
Sensex and Nifty opening higher despite a global sell-off
Investor preference for largecap stocks in anticipation of the next market rally
Recovery in market sentiment following the Nifty Bank's record-breaking performance
whatHappening: Sensex jumps over 600 points while Nifty 50 trades above the 25,400 mark
Nifty Bank hits a record high above 62,300, leading the market rally
NSE's market capitalization crosses ₹5 trillion as its shares reach an all-time high
Analysts warn of a potential fall despite the current rally due to high market premiums
summary: Indian markets are rallying with the Sensex up 600 points and Nifty Bank reaching a record high above 62,300. NSE's market capitalization has crossed ₹5 trillion, while Asian Paints and SBI are among the top gainers. However, analysts caution investors to prepare for potential corrections amid concerns over high market premiums.
